title: /compare-formats
summary: Slash command that runs the round-trip judge on a variant: per-dimension fidelity, originality gate, proposed IR patches and the stop decision.
description: Score a variant against its source format and propose IR fixes. Captures technique and structure only; never stores or reuses the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text.

side_effects: runs ffmpeg/ffprobe and Python modules; writes evidence, answers, IR and reports under the chosen output directory
